parent_objective: export a source-labeled M1069 failed-row projection corpus before any repair optimizer
blocked_by: M1071 requires a combined source-diverse failed-row corpus before projection can be tested
invalidates: running repair/projection with only the old M1037 row15/row16 anchor
collapsing M1061 family-intersection source rows into one unlabeled corpus

public_gates: M1072 must not use private holdout
M1072 must export or validate source-labeled failed rows from old public replay, M1061 family-intersection, and source-diverse surfaces
M1072 must validate that exported tensors load under the P0 actor contract
forbidden_shortcuts: do not drop M1061 failed rows
do not merge source-policy rows without source labels

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: builds the proof-surface data needed before a no-PPO repair/projection probe can be run
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: corpus/export sanity only; no training, no promotion, no repaired checkpoint claim
stop_condition: stop if failed rows cannot be matched back to boundary corpus tensors
stop if source labels cannot be preserved
stop if exported corpus fails loader validation
fallback_plan: if export passes, route to no-PPO repair/projection probe
if old/source-diverse NPZ artifacts are missing, route to boundary corpus reconstruction tooling
if family rows cannot be combined safely, route to multi-source conflict-corpus implementation
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1071 designs projection-first repair and requires a failed-row corpus before optimizer work

hypothesis: M1069 failed rows can be exported into a source-labeled projection corpus that preserves old public, M1061 family-intersection, and source-diverse proof constraints without training.
success_criteria: old public failed rows are represented
M1061 family-intersection failed rows are represented
source labels and source checkpoints are preserved
exported tensors load under the P0 actor contract
no PPO actor training promotion or private holdout occurs
failure_criteria: failed rows cannot be matched to source corpora

commands.name: export_failed_row_projection_corpus
commands.command: export source-labeled M1069 failed-row projection corpus and write docs/m1072-v4-public-base-medium-ppo-failed-row-projection-corpus-export.md

decision_rule: M1072 may only export/validate failed-row projection corpora. It cannot run PPO, optimize actor weights, promote, or use private holdout.
